module_summary: httpsupport.cpp is the HTTP game source: it fetches and parses a games.csv catalog from a static web server, probes ISO size and DVD layer break with byte-range GETs, and patches the http cdvdman settings before launch; it also implements the Network page Test button. mmcesupport.cpp is the MMCE (SD2PSX/MemCard PRO2) game source plus the GameID transport: slot detection with debounce, ISO/PS1 list scans, the card-switch waits shown on screen, and the native and Neutrino launch legs. netsupport.cpp/.h own the shared menu TCP/IP stack (netman, smap, ps2ip, ps2ips, httpclient) used by SMB, NFS and HTTP, with the NIC interlocks against UDPBD/UDPFS, link-mode/IP/DHCP application and a bounded teardown. nettime.h declares the Date-header clock sync implemented in src/sources/nettime.cpp.

reusable_helpers.name: httpNormalizeBasePath
reusable_helpers.what: normalises a URL base path: leading '/', no trailing '/' except the root

reusable_helpers.name: httpBuildPath
reusable_helpers.what: joins a base path and a relative path with RFC 3986 percent-encoding of everything outside the unreserved set

reusable_helpers.name: httpServerIpString
reusable_helpers.what: formats a 4-int IP array as a dotted quad string

reusable_helpers.name: httpProbeRead
reusable_helpers.what: reads exactly N bytes at an offset over one ranged HTTP GET

reusable_helpers.name: HttpSupport::localPrefix
reusable_helpers.what: home path with a guaranteed trailing '/' or ':' separator, mc0:OPL fallback

reusable_helpers.name: mmceSlotOf
reusable_helpers.what: parses mmce0:/mmce1: device root to slot 0/1 or -1

reusable_helpers.name: mmceStartPressed / mmceSleepReadingStart
reusable_helpers.what: latched START-key skip and a sleep that samples the pad about once per frame

reusable_helpers.name: MmceSupport::getDeviceRoot
reusable_helpers.what: derives the device root 'devN:/' from a prefix path

reusable_helpers.name: NetSupport::waitValidState
reusable_helpers.what: bounded 1 s alarm/semaphore poll of a predicate, up to 30 s

reusable_helpers.name: NetSupport::applyNetifConfig
reusable_helpers.what: maps the ETH op-mode setting to a NetMan link mode and applies it only on change

findings.title: NetSupport class in netsupport.h is private state behind a public class plus nine one-line forwarders (and two more in ethsupport.cpp)
findings.problem: gNetSupport and class NetSupport are used only inside netsupport.cpp; every caller uses the netXxx free functions, each a one-line forward to a method. waitValidLinkState/waitValidDhcpState are one-line wrappers, the NetStatusCheckCb forward declaration precedes a definition that already comes before its use, and ethGetNetConfig/ethGetDHCPStatus forward again to netGetConfig/netGetDHCPStatus, so a caller goes through three layers.
findings.fix: Delete the class from netsupport.h; keep the members as file-static variables in netsupport.cpp and turn each method into the netXxx function (or a static helper) directly. Delete the two waitValid wrappers and the forward declaration. Optionally point ethGetNetConfig/ethGetDHCPStatus callers at netGetConfig/netGetDHCPStatus and delete those two. Update the source-text tests that pin the method names (.github/scripts/test_pccf.py:38, test_smb2_menu_wait_bounds.py:95-146).
findings.benefit: ~70 source lines removed (46-line class in the header, ~40 lines of forwarders, ~9 lines of wrappers, offset by ~8 lines of file statics); no ELF change worth stating, forwarders are tiny (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep gNetSupport over the repo (excluding docs): netsupport.h:63,106 (comment, extern) and netsupport.cpp only. Grep NetSupport outside netsupport.cpp: header, docs/CPP-CONVERSION-PLAN.md, and two source-text tests (test_pccf.py:38, test_smb2_menu_wait_bounds.py:95-146) that match method signatures. Callers of the free functions: ethsupport.cpp:209,370,451,526,673,698,720,1648,1653, guisettings.cpp:155, httpsupport.cpp:891. ethGetNetConfig/ethGetDHCPStatus at ethsupport.cpp:1646-1654 only forward.

findings.title: HttpSource overrides prefix, deleteGame and checkVmc with bodies identical to the GameSource defaults
findings.problem: GameSource::prefix returns NULL, GameSource::deleteGame is empty and GameSource::checkVmc returns -1 (gamesource.cpp:24,25,27; virtual, not pure, gamesource.h:35,44,52). HttpSource's overrides do exactly the same thing, so the three overrides and their declarations add code and vtable entries for no behaviour.
findings.fix: Delete the three override declarations and the three definitions (keep rename, which is pure virtual). Move the one useful sentence of the checkVmc comment (no VMC over HTTP) next to the class if wanted.
findings.benefit: ~30 source lines removed; three small functions dropped from the ELF (they are vtable-referenced so --gc-sections keeps them today), well under 100 bytes (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read gamesource.h:35-54 (prefix, deleteGame, checkVmc are virtual with definitions) and gamesource.cpp:24-27 (return NULL / {} / return -1). Read httpsupport.cpp:539-545, 660-664, 898-912: same results. Grep HttpSource::(checkVmc|prefix|deleteGame) over the repo: only the definitions; no source-text test pins them.

findings.title: httpTestServer re-implements httpProbeRead for its 2 KB range probe
findings.problem: The Test button's probe (openRequest with a range, read loop until 2048 bytes or EOF, close, then check got == 2048 && hasTotal) is the same logic as httpProbeRead, which does openRequest, the same read loop, close, and returns got == length && hasTotal. httpProbeRead is defined later in the file, which is probably why it was copied.
findings.fix: Move httpProbeRead (and httpProbeImage if preferred) above httpTestServer and replace lines 474-497 with one call: httpProbeRead(&testEndpoint, probePath, 0, 2048, probe, &total), showing _STR_HTTP_ERR_RANGE on 0. Drop the now unused locals contentLen, hasTotal, sock, r and the extra brace blocks.
findings.benefit: ~18 source lines removed; a few dozen bytes of code (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read httpsupport.cpp:421-501 and 676-697 side by side: same openRequest(..., 1, from, to, ...) call, same while (got < len) HttpStreamRead loop breaking on n <= 0, same HttpCloseConnection, same got == length && hasTotal test. Grep httpProbeRead: defined at 676, called at 714 and 726 only.

findings.title: httpLastError is written in nine places but never read by shipped code
findings.problem: The comments say httpLastError holds an error 'the UI can name', but no UI code reads it: the only read anywhere is the host test tools/pc/http/tests/test_catalog_limits.py:77, which stubs the symbol itself. The UI shows fixed strings (_STR_HTTP_ERR_*) instead.
findings.fix: Delete the variable, its nine assignments and the comment text that promises it to the UI; drop the matching stub and assert from test_catalog_limits.py (or keep only the row-limit return check there).
findings.benefit: ~14 source lines removed; 4 bytes .bss and a few stores (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep httpLastError over the whole repo (excluding docs): httpsupport.cpp:52 (definition), 151 and 251 (comments), writes at 211, 262, 268, 274, 279, 302, 326, 347; httpsupport.h:60 (comment); tools/pc/http/tests/test_catalog_limits.py:38 (stub definition) and :77 (assert). No other read.

findings.title: MmceSource::launch carries dead autolaunch branches, a commented-out block and other commented-out code
findings.problem: gAutoLaunchBDMGame is only set by autoLaunchBDMGame (autolaunch.cpp:138), which runs miniInit(BDM_MODE) and launches through bdmLaunchGame (autolaunch.cpp:292); it never reaches MmceSource::launch, so the gAutoLaunchBDMGame tests are always false/true and the 'No autolaunch yet' block at 1735-1741 is commented out. With game always from activeGame (never NULL, returns &emptyGame), the game != NULL tests at 1314/1330/1333/1339 are always true. cleanUp/shutdown hold commented-out code, and <usbhdfsd-common.h> is included only for the commented USBMASS_DEVCTL_STOP_ALL line.
findings.fix: Delete the gAutoLaunchBDMGame branches (game = activeGame(...) unconditionally; call deinit unconditionally), the commented-out blocks at 1735-1741, 1801-1802, 1818-1819, the always-true game != NULL tests, and the usbhdfsd-common.h include.
findings.benefit: ~18 source lines removed; no ELF change beyond a few compares (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep 'gAutoLaunchBDMGame =' over src: set only at autolaunch.cpp:138, cleared at opl.cpp:1495, autolaunch.cpp:156/185/259/282/303, bdmlaunch.cpp:362/503/968 and the commented line mmcesupport.cpp:1740. autolaunch.cpp launch calls: hddLaunchGame (118), bdmLaunchGame (292) only; autolaunch.cpp references mmce only for mmceLoadModules in boot-dir resolution. activeGame (mmcesupport.cpp:1103-1112) never returns NULL. Grep USBMASS_ in mmcesupport.cpp: only the commented line 1819.

findings.title: Art path composition (prefix+folder/value_suffix or folder+value_suffix, then texDiscoverArt) is repeated in five game sources
findings.problem: Each image() override builds the same two snprintf formats ('%s%s/%s_%s' with a prefix, '%s%s_%s' without) into a 256-byte buffer and calls texDiscoverArt; mmceTryLoadImage is already this exact helper but is static and has a single caller (MmceSource::image, which then just returns its result).
findings.fix: Move mmceTryLoadImage to supportbase.cpp as one shared helper (prefix, folder, isRelative, value, suffix, tex) and make the five image() overrides call it (udpfs passes its case-mapped folder). Delete the per-source copies and the long repeated 'ART LIVES IN THE ART FOLDER' comments.
findings.justification: The helper already exists (mmceTryLoadImage); making it shared replaces five 5-line copies with one-line calls, a net reduction, and keeps the art lookup rule in one place.
findings.benefit: ~12 net source lines removed (5 copies x ~4 lines = 20, minus ~8 for the shared helper); a few hundred bytes of duplicated code (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep '"%s%s/%s_%s"' over src: bdmsupport.cpp:2089, udpfssupport.cpp:1210, mmcesupport.cpp:658, httpsupport.cpp:872, hddsupport.cpp:2955; each followed by the '%s%s_%s' else branch and texDiscoverArt. Grep mmceTryLoadImage: definition 650 and one call at 1768.

findings.title: MmceSupport::artPrimary is always a plain copy of prefix
findings.problem: refreshArtRoots clears artPrimary, appends '/' to prefix, then copies prefix into artPrimary; artPrimary is read only by MmceSource::image. It is rewritten at the same points as prefix, so it is not a race-safe snapshot either, and the plural 'ArtRoots' is left from a removed multi-root art search.
findings.fix: Delete artPrimary; keep only the trailing-slash normalisation (rename refreshArtRoots to something like normalisePrefix) and pass prefix (or a local copy) to the art loader.
findings.benefit: 40 bytes .bss (char artPrimary[40], INFERRED) and ~5 source lines removed.
findings.evidence: Grep artPrimary over the repo (excluding docs): mmceint.h:62 (member), mmcesupport.cpp:634, 647 (writes in refreshArtRoots), 842 (init clear), 1768 (only read). refreshArtRoots called at 730 (end of setPrefix) and 1589 (after detectSlot in launch), i.e. always right after prefix changes.

findings.title: Small copy-paste in mmcesupport.cpp: slot-candidate loop, card-ready tail, list frees, constant temporaries
findings.problem: sendGameID and resetCards open-code the same 'configured slot, then mmce0, then mmce1, skip tried' loop, parsing the slot by hand (strlen < 5, [4]-'0', 0..1) although mmceSlotOf (98-103) does exactly that. Inside sendGameID the 'waitCardReady, <0 return -1, ==0 break, log, return 1' tail appears twice. update(), cleanUp() and shutdown() each free and NULL both game lists (update with redundant NULL checks); shutdown's body equals cleanUp's. textId/iconId copy a constant into a local before returning it.
findings.fix: Use mmceSlotOf in both candidate loops; let the silent-swap branch fall into the shared card-ready tail (set a flag, or goto); make shutdown call cleanUp; drop the NULL checks before free; return the constants directly.
findings.benefit: ~20 source lines removed; no measurable ELF change (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read mmcesupport.cpp:146-305 and 547-590: identical cands/tried loop headers (176-185, 562-571) and identical ready-handling blocks (259-265, 280-286). Read 1027-1052, 1791-1820: same free/NULL pairs; shutdown 1809-1816 equals cleanUp 1793-1800 apart from the LOG text. mmceSlotOf (98) is used at 439, 455 only. Risk Med because sendGameID is on the launch path.

findings.title: Stale history and contradictory comments in mmcesupport.cpp and netsupport.cpp/.h
findings.problem: Several comments only record where code used to be ('moved ABOVE', 'hoisted above', 'moved verbatim out of src/ethsupport.c'), and netsupport.h names ethsupport.c/httpsupport.c, which are now .cpp. The Neutrino GameID comment at 1646-1655 says the native OPL-core launch deliberately does NOT send a GameID, which the code at 1399-1414 and the 'CORRECTED HISTORY' essay at 1712-1721 contradict.
findings.fix: Delete the 'moved/hoisted' notes and the history essay at 1712-1721; cut 1646-1655 to one line saying Neutrino has no mcemu so the card must be told the game; fix the file names in netsupport.h.
findings.benefit: ~25 comment lines removed; no binary change.
findings.evidence: Read mmcesupport.cpp:908-924 (where the Themes/Languages block now is), 1318-1336 (quiesce now above the VCD handoff), 1381-1387 (last-played now before the switch), 1399-1414 (native send exists), 1646-1655 and 1712-1721. Glob: src/sources/ethsupport.cpp and httpsupport.cpp exist, no .c files of those names.

findings.title: HttpSupport::clearCatalog duplicates setCatalog(NULL, NULL, 0); httpParseCatalog has an if/else with identical branches
findings.problem: clearCatalog frees games_/extras_ (with NULL checks free() does not need), NULLs them and zeroes the count, which is exactly setCatalog(NULL, NULL, 0); its only caller is HttpSource::cleanUp (884). In httpParseCatalog both branches of 'if (nl < end) *nl = 0; else *nl = 0;' do the same store.
findings.fix: Delete clearCatalog (and its declaration, httpsupport.h:50) and call setCatalog(NULL, NULL, 0) in cleanUp; replace the if/else with the single store and its comment.
findings.benefit: ~15 source lines removed; no measurable ELF change (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read httpsupport.cpp:376-396 and 182-185. Grep clearCatalog over the repo (excluding docs): httpsupport.h:45 (comment), :50 (declaration), httpsupport.cpp:385 (definition), :884 (only call). httpParseCatalog is extracted verbatim by tools/pc/http/tests/test_catalog_limits.py, which still compiles with the single store.

findings.title: HttpSource constructor stores MODE_FLAG_NO_UPDATE in enabled, so HTTP reads as enabled before init
findings.problem: The constructor sets enabled = MODE_FLAG_NO_UPDATE (0x04, iosupport.h:94) to preserve an old positional-initializer slip, as its own comment says. Every other source starts disabled and sets enabled = 1 in init. guiRefreshCfgTitles tests http->enabled and so queues an HTTP list update even when the HTTP source was never initialised.
findings.fix: Delete the constructor body (lines 512-515) so enabled starts at 0 like the other sources; init() already sets it to 1.
findings.benefit: 4 lines removed and one spurious deferred HTTP update request avoided on settings apply when HTTP is not started (INFERRED: HttpSource::update returns early when the protocol is not HTTP).
findings.evidence: Read httpsupport.cpp:510-516, 559-568, 580-594; iosupport.h:94 (MODE_FLAG_NO_UPDATE 0x04, 'Retired updater capability bit'); guisettings.cpp:593-595 reads http->enabled; httpGetObject ignores initOnly (920). INFERRED part: that no other code relies on the non-zero pre-init value; grep of '->enabled' readers (menusys.cpp:384, menuitems.cpp:121/179/217, guigame.cpp:675/761/768) all go through registered supports.
